text:
emily: Quick thread  benchmark launch creative: want a single narrative that ties latency -> dollars with a contour chart + a savings matrix. also want a gated Jupyter notebook calculator (not just a sheet) to appeal to devs. thoughts?
jord: Love the notebook idea. Interactive sliders (tokens/min, batch size, quant) -> outputs $/mo and p95. We can host as a runnable binder or provide notebook + CSV.
rashid: Chart ideas: contour plot (x=latency target p95, y=throughput qps) with color = $ / 1k requests. Shows iso-cost lines so you can pick an SLO and read cost. second viz = 3x3 savings matrix (workload vs knob).
noor: Messaging: headline "Pick your SLO, see your bill." social: "Contour your latency-to-dollar tradeoffs  run our notebook." Keep tone technical but approachable.
benchbot: data snapshot: https://internal.benchmarks.redwood/1788888888  file bench-contour-v2.csv (includes batch sizes 1/8/32, cache on/off, q4/q8 variants).
jem: (typo)
jord: Routing: signup for the notebook -> capture email + monthly_tokens_estimate + primary_use_case. Buckets: <100k self-serve, 100k-1M nurture, >1M SDR. Also flag "wants-demo" if they check box.
rashid: Visual notes: make iso-cost lines labeled with $/1k, mark a sample customer point and show recommended knob set (batch=8, cache on, q4). Export PNG 1200x630 and an interactive Vega-Lite embed for blog.
noor: Webinar 20m: 1) show contour + interpret, 2) live-run notebook on a sample app, 3) playbook: configs + rollout checklist. CTA variants to A/B test on landing: "Run the notebook" vs "Estimate my token bill".
emily: Tech CTA: also include a curl example for teams who want a quick API estimate. jord, can you draft?
jord: sample curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/estimate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-q4","tokens_per_min":5000,"batch":8,"cache":true}'
rashid: Analytics: track which CTA is clicked, notebook run (yes/no), and if sample curl used. Tag leads with "bench_contour".
noor: Microcopy near notebook: "Estimates assume your tokenization & steady throughput; spikes and prompt changes will alter costs." Also include an uncertainty band on contour lines.
emily: Timeline: draft contour + notebook prototype by Tue, visuals Wed, gated notebook + page Fri, webinar 2 weeks out. Owners: jord notebook/API, rashid visuals + data, noor copy + routing, emily launch.
jord: I'll push a minimal binder that runs headless by Tue AM.
rashid: I'll annotate the kneepoint numbers and upload CSV.
noor: I'll wire the signup form + zap to CRM staging Thu.
emily: Great  small asks: rashid include alt text and thumbnail-friendly labels, jord make notebook runnable with sample dataset, noor prepare two CTA variants for A/B test. We'll review Tue afternoon. :white_check_mark:
